dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open Cases: Clique-Width Classification for $(H_1,H_2)$-Free Graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Determine, for each of the five remaining pairs $(H_1, H_2)$, whether the class of $(H_1, H_2)$-free graphs has bounded or unbounded clique-width.
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper continues a project [4,8,11,12,14,15] classifying the boundedness of clique-width of $(H_1,H_2)$-free graph classes. By showing that (gem, $P_1+2P_2$)-free graphs have unbounded clique-width, the authors reduce the number of open pairs from six to five.
